page.library: The videos in your directories. Analyze a video to find who appears in it, then open it to generate its thumbnails, titles and descriptions.
page.video_not_analyzed: This video is not analyzed yet. The analysis extracts the frames of each scene, groups the faces by person and transcribes the audio. When it finishes you can generate thumbnails.
page.video_generate: Choose who appears, where it happens and how many thumbnails you want, and press the generate button. Under each person you see the photos of them the AI gets and, next to the button, how many images that is in total. "Look" and "Advanced" are optional: folded, they still show their values, and clicking them opens them to change them. They start as in Settings (in the header); what you change here applies to this video only and is highlighted.
page.video_people: The people the analysis found in the video. With the pencil you name them, review their frames and choose the photos of their face and body the AI gets. Check several to merge or delete them.
page.video_thumbnails: Every thumbnail generated for this video. Hover one to download it, see the original without face swap, redo the face or delete it.
page.video_texts: Generate titles and descriptions from the transcript. Star the titles you want the thumbnails to draw on.
page.video_transcript: What is said in the video, by voice. The AI reads it to create the thumbnails, the titles and the descriptions.
page.person_editor: A person of the video. On the left, their frames: select them to add them, move them to another person, remove them or use them as a photo of their face or body. On the right, their name, their notes and "What the AI sees", the photos of them sent when generating. The panel is saved with "Save changes"; what you do with the frames applies at once.
page.person_new: Create a person by hand: find their faces in "Unassigned" or "Whole video", select them and add them. Their face photos are chosen automatically while you add frames. Then name them and press "Create person".

flow.analyze_text: The frames of each scene are extracted, faces are grouped by person and the audio is transcribed.
flow.people_text: Name them and review the photos of them the AI gets: three clear, different faces are usually enough.
flow.generate_text: Choose who will be in them and how many thumbnails you want. One AI comes up with the idea of each one (scene, pose, text) and another draws it with their faces.
flow.pick_text: Review the thumbnails, redo the face of the ones that need it and download the ones you like.

glossary.frame_text: An image taken from the video. The analysis keeps several from each scene.
glossary.face_photo_text: A photo of a person's face sent to the image AI so it knows what they look like. The analysis picks up to three different ones; you can change them in their editor.
glossary.style_image_text: An optional image used as a visual guide: colors, style, composition. It is nobody's face.
glossary.face_swap_text: Replaces the generated face using the person's photos. Use only if the likeness is poor: facial expressions may be lost or changed. You can always view the original.
glossary.scene_view_text: Splits each person by scene. Useful when someone changes look a lot (costume, make-up) during the video.
glossary.gran_sabio_text: The service that writes the thumbnail ideas, the titles and the descriptions. Nothing can be generated without it.
glossary.idea_text: What the AI decides before drawing each thumbnail: the scene, the pose, the expression and the text. Gran Sabio writes it and the image AI draws it.
glossary.collage_text: Experimental option of a person's editor: their face photos together in one image instead of each one separately.
glossary.background_text: The place where the thumbnail happens. The AI imagines it or recreates it from photos of the video or uploaded ones (step 2 of Generate).

settings.title: Settings
settings.open_hint: Which AI does what, and what every video starts with
settings.intro: They apply to every video. What you change inside a video, in "Look" or "Advanced", applies to that video only.
settings.ideas_info: Writes the idea of each thumbnail (scene, pose and text) from the transcript, the face photos and the style image, through Gran Sabio. It must be a model that sees images.
settings.drawing_info: Draws each thumbnail from its idea and the face photos.
settings.defaults_info: What the "Generate" tab has when you open a video. There you can change it for that video only.
settings.writer_info: Writes the titles and descriptions from the transcript, through Gran Sabio. A text model is enough.
settings.openrouter_info: OpenRouter models run through Gran Sabio. Thumbnail ideas require vision. Prices are input/output USD per million tokens, as listed by Gran Sabio.
settings.local_text_info: Local text models run through Gran Sabio. Configure their server in Gran Sabio.
